samples.summary: The toolbar/EditorAPI Clear-formatting path still extends a hyperlink at its trailing edge — the fix this delta added to `TextEditor.clearFormatting` was not propagated to `EditorAPI.clearInlineFormatting`
samples.evidence: `EditorAPI.clearInlineFormatting` (packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:3344-3350) routes into `applyStyleImpl`, whose collapsed-caret branch is `pending.set({ ...getSelectionStyleImpl(), ...style }, cursor.position)` (editor.ts:1167-1174). `getSelectionStyleImpl` → `caretInlineStyle` returns the run the caret sits in, and at a link's trailing edge (`position.offset <= inlineEnd`) that run's style INCLUDES `href` (packages/docs/src/model/caret-style.ts:71-78). Since this PR removed `href` from `CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE`, the constant no longer overrides it, so the staged pending style keeps `href: 'https://…'`. Nothing re-arms the exit for an ordinary typed character — `exitLinkIfAtTrailingEdge` is only called on space (text-editor.ts:980-982), Enter (2608, 2641) and paste (4171) — so click Clear formatting with a collapsed caret at the end of a link, type `x`, and the `x` is inside the link. This is exactly the regression the delta guards against on the keyboard path (text-editor.ts:3440-3448) and the case the new test `Cmd+\ at a link trailing edge still exits the link` covers; the toolbar entry point has no equivalent guard or test. The docs design doc claims parity for all three entry points (docs/design/docs/docs-font-controls.md:263-284), which is now inaccurate for the toolbar. Fix belongs in `applyStyleImpl`'s collapsed branch (or in `clearInlineFormatting` before delegating), mirroring the trailing-edge re-arm.

verdict.reason: Every element of the finding checks out in the repository. editor.ts:3344-3350 routes the toolbar Clear-formatting into applyStyleImpl(CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE); the collapsed-caret branch at editor.ts:1170 stages `{ ...caretInlineStyle(...), ...style }`. caret-style.ts:74-75 returns the run's style — href included — when `position.offset === inlineEnd` (the link's trailing edge), and types.ts:283-315 shows CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE deliberately has no `href` key, so the spread cannot override the inherited href. pending-style.ts:28-42 then applies that style, href and all, to the next typed run. The keyboard path got the re-arm (text-editor.ts:3439-3448 using isAtLinkTrailingEdge at 5908-5923); grepping href across editor.ts shows no equivalent guard on the toolbar path, and exitLinkIfAtTrailingEdge is only invoked for space (981), Enter (2608, 2641) and paste (4171) — never for an ordinary typed character. The path is reachable: pending is shared via editor.ts:2506 setPendingStyle, and docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx:520-523 calls clearInlineFormatting() with no selection precondition. Test coverage confirms the asymmetry: link-trailing-edge.test.ts:236-250 locks the behaviour for Cmd+\, while editor-clear-formatting.test.ts has no collapsed-caret trailing-edge case. Real contract change with an unupdated consumer outside the diff; wrong result at the cited site — major, in lane.

finding.summary: Slides has no reachable way to remove a hyperlink once Clear formatting stops doing it
finding.evidence: `slides-view.tsx:738-741` states the link popover is "intentionally unwired — ... Cmd+K no-ops at the editor level until then", and a grep of packages/frontend/src/app/slides/** finds no removeLink/getLinkAtCursor/unlink UI (only the docs popover at packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-link-popover.tsx:154 calls removeLink). Slides text-box runs can still gain an href — the shared TextEditor.tryAutoLinkBeforeCursor (packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:2913) autolinks a typed URL, and PPTX import carries hyperlinks. The new contract says removeLink is the separate command that drops one, but packages/slides/src/view/editor/text-box-editor.ts:650 removeLink is only exposed on the API, never bound to a toolbar or popover, so after this change a Slides user cannot unlink a run at all (Clear formatting used to). Fix belongs in the Slides UI rather than in the diff.

verdict.reason: The finding claims Slides has no reachable way to remove a hyperlink now that Clear formatting preserves hrefs. A counterexample exists, reached through the shared text-formatting component rather than a Slides-local file (which is why the reviewer's app/slides greps came up empty). text-format-group.tsx:310-325 renders a ToolbarButton with aria-label "Remove link" whenever the showRemoveLink prop is set, and its onClick handler at text-format-group.tsx:174-178 calls editor.removeLink?.() then editor.focus(). The Slides text-edit toolbar opts in: text-edit-section.tsx:89-94 passes showRemoveLink with editor={textEditor} (the active SlidesTextBoxEditor), and that section is genuinely mounted at slides/toolbar/index.tsx:136-138 when state.kind === "text-edit" (and is reused by board/board-toolbar.tsx:444). The mobile sheet does the same at mobile-toolbar.tsx:576-581. removeLink is a required, non-optional member of the Slides text editor contract at packages/slides/src/view/editor/text-box-editor.ts:270 and is implemented at :650-651, so the optional call always resolves for these call sites. The reviewer's own quoted comment refutes the claim once read past line 742: slides-view.tsx:743-750 states that removing a link is possible and that "The text-edit toolbar therefore renders a Remove link button (toolbar/text-edit-section.tsx, showRemoveLink) wired to the text box's removeLink()". Tests for both Slides surfaces stub removeLink (frontend/tests/app/slides/toolbar/text-edit-section.test.ts:37 and mobile-text-toggles.test.ts:71). The docs popover is thus not the only consumer, and Slides users retain a reachable unlink path.

finding.summary: Cmd+\ now wipes the trailing-edge `href: undefined` pending style, so typing after a clear at a link's end extends the hyperlink
finding.evidence: exitLinkIfAtTrailingEdge (packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:5918-5922) arms pending with { ...visual, href: undefined } so the next typed character escapes the link. clearFormatting() (:3431) *replaces* that pending state with CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE, which no longer contains an href key at all; createPendingStyle.set (packages/docs/src/view/pending-style.ts:22) overwrites rather than merges, and an absent key in the merge patch means "leave the run's value alone", so text typed after Cmd+\ at a link's trailing edge now inherits the neighbouring run's href. Previously the shortcut's own list carried href: undefined and preserved the escape. The docs toolbar path has the same shape at packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:1170, where the caret style (including the live href) is merged under the clear patch.

verdict.reason: Half the finding is wrong, half is real, so it survives. The headline claim about the Cmd+\ path is NOT as described: text-editor.ts:3439-3448 already re-arms the escape, setting `{ ...CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE, href: undefined }` whenever `isAtLinkTrailingEdge(this.cursor.position)` (text-editor.ts:5908-5923) is true or a prior pending state carried `href: undefined`. That path is already-guarded. However, the same finding also cites packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:1170, and that site is a genuine, reachable bypass of the same invariant: `applyStyleImpl` on a collapsed caret does `pending.set({ ...getSelectionStyleImpl(), ...style }, cursor.position)`, and `caretInlineStyle` (model/caret-style.ts:71-78) returns the link run's style — `href` included — when the caret sits at the run's trailing edge (`position.offset <= inlineEnd`). Because `CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE` (model/types.ts:300-315) no longer contains an `href` key, the merge leaves the live href in the pending style and clobbers the `href: undefined` armed by `exitLinkIfAtTrailingEdge` (text-editor.ts:5935-5940); both share one PendingStyle instance (editor.ts:1079 created, editor.ts:2506 handed to the text editor). The path is reachable from the docs toolbar: docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx:521 -> editor.ts:3344 `clearInlineFormatting` -> `applyStyleImpl(CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE)`. Result: Clear formatting at a link's trailing edge followed by typing extends the hyperlink — the exact regression the text-editor path took care to prevent. That is a new-guard-with-a-bypass in another entry point, squarely in the blast-radius lane, so I cannot drop the finding; the fix belongs at editor.ts:1170 (or in a shared helper), and the reviewer's text-editor.ts location should be re-pointed there.
